archive_runs_period_check.name: archive_runs_period_check
archive_runs_period_check.value:
"archive_runs"."period_start" = (
        pg_catalog.date_trunc('month', "archive_runs"."period_start" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
      )
      AND "archive_runs"."period_end" = "archive_runs"."period_start" + INTERVAL '1 month'

archive_runs_key_period_check.name: archive_runs_key_period_check
archive_runs_key_period_check.value:
CASE
      WHEN "archive_runs"."archive_key" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0?[1-9]|1[0-2])-[jd]$' THEN
        pg_catalog.split_part("archive_runs"."archive_key", '-', 1)::INTEGER
          = pg_catalog.extract(YEAR FROM "archive_runs"."period_start" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::INTEGER
        AND pg_catalog.split_part("archive_runs"."archive_key", '-', 2)::INTEGER
          = pg_catalog.extract(MONTH FROM "archive_runs"."period_start" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::INTEGER
        AND (
          ("archive_runs"."data_type" = 'jobs' AND "archive_runs"."archive_key" ~ '-j$')
          OR ("archive_runs"."data_type" = 'documents' AND "archive_runs"."archive_key" ~ '-d$')
        )
        AND "archive_runs"."segment" = 1
      WHEN "archive_runs"."archive_key" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-[jd]-s[0-9]{6}$' THEN
        pg_catalog.split_part("archive_runs"."archive_key", '-', 1)::INTEGER
          = pg_catalog.extract(YEAR FROM "archive_runs"."period_start" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::INTEGER
        AND pg_catalog.split_part("archive_runs"."archive_key", '-', 2)::INTEGER
          = pg_catalog.extract(MONTH FROM "archive_runs"."period_start" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::INTEGER
        AND (
          ("archive_runs"."data_type" = 'jobs' AND "archive_runs"."archive_key" ~ '-j-s[0-9]{6}$')
          OR ("archive_runs"."data_type" = 'documents' AND "archive_runs"."archive_key" ~ '-d-s[0-9]{6}$')
        )
        AND pg_catalog.split_part("archive_runs"."archive_key", '-s', 2)::INTEGER = "archive_runs"."segment"
      ELSE false
    END
